title: Bring on the learning revolution! | Ken Robinson
speaker: Ken Robinson

sentences.en: I was here four years ago, and I remember, at the time, that the talks weren't put online.
sentences.zh: 四年前我站在这里，我记得在那个时候，演讲不是放在网上；

sentences.en: I think they were given to TEDsters in a box, a box set of DVDs, which they put on their shelves, where they are now.
sentences.zh: 我想演讲是放在盒子里 送给 TEDsters (TED出席者)，一整盒子的 DVD，TEDsters 把它们放到书架上， 它们现在应该还被搁在那。

sentences.en: (Laughter) And actually, Chris called me a week after I'd given my talk, and said, "We're going to start putting them online. Can we put yours online?"
sentences.zh: （笑声）事实上，克里斯在我演讲后一个礼拜，打电话给我，说: “我们准备把它们放到网上。能把你的也放到网上吗？” 我说: “当然。”

sentences.en: And I said, "Sure." And four years later, it's been downloaded four million times.
sentences.zh: 四年以后，就像我说的，已经有四 ...嗯，它已经被下载了四百万次。

sentences.en: So I suppose you could multiply that by 20 or something to get the number of people who've seen it.
sentences.zh: 所以我推断，将它 乘以 20 或者其它数字，你就知道有多少人看过它了。

sentences.en: And, as Chris says, there is a hunger for videos of me.
sentences.zh: 就像克里斯说的，人们对我的视频相当感兴趣。

sentences.en: (Laughter) (Applause) Don't you feel? (Laughter)
sentences.zh: （笑声）（掌声）难道你们不这样认为吗？（笑声）

sentences.en: So, this whole event has been an elaborate build-up to me doing another one for you, so here it is.
sentences.zh: 因此，今天这个精心制作准备的演讲，就是为你们而量身订做的。

sentences.en: (Laughter) Al Gore spoke at the TED conference I spoke at four years ago and talked about the climate crisis.
sentences.zh: （笑声）阿尔·戈尔 (Al Gore) 在 TED 研讨会上有过演讲，那年我也在那儿演说，而他谈的是气候危机。

sentences.en: And I referenced that at the end of my last talk.
sentences.zh: 在我在那次演讲的最后

sentences.en: So I want to pick up from there because I only had 18 minutes, frankly.
sentences.zh: 引用了他的话。所以我想从那儿开始，

sentences.en: (Laughter) So, as I was saying -- (Laughter) You see, he's right.
sentences.zh: 因为，坦率的讲，我仅有 18 分钟。正如同我所说过的...（笑声）

sentences.en: I mean, there is a major climate crisis, obviously, and I think if people don't believe it, they should get out more.
sentences.zh: 你看，他是正确的。我是说，很显然地， 严重的气候危机的确存在。我认为如果你不相信它， 你就应该想法了解了解。

sentences.en: (Laughter) But I believe there is a second climate crisis, which is as severe, which has the same origins, and that we have to deal with the same urgency.
sentences.zh: （笑声）但是，我相信还有个第二大气候危机，它同样很严重并且有着相同的起源，我们也必须紧急处理它。我是说 --

sentences.en: And you may say, by the way, "Look, I'm good.
sentences.zh: 但你也许说: “看，够了。我已经有一个气候危机；

sentences.en: I have one climate crisis, I don't really need the second one."
sentences.zh: 我不需要再有第二个了。”

sentences.en: (Laughter) But this is a crisis of, not natural resources -- though I believe that's true -- but a crisis of human resources.
sentences.zh: 但是，这个与自然资源无关的危机 --即使我相信确实存在自然灾害的危机 --即为人力资源的危机。

sentences.en: I believe fundamentally, as many speakers have said during the past few days, that we make very poor use of our talents.
sentences.zh: 我相信，从根本上说，就像许多演讲者 在过去的几天中说的，我们完全没有好好地利用我们自己的天赋。

sentences.en: Very many people go through their whole lives having no real sense of what their talents may be, or if they have any to speak of.
sentences.zh: 许多人回顾他们的整个人生，完全不知道他们的天赋是什么，或者他们从未提及 任何关于他们天赋的事。

sentences.en: I meet all kinds of people who don't think they're really good at anything.
sentences.zh: 我遇到过各种各样的人，他们不认为自己 擅长于任何一件事。

sentences.en: Actually, I kind of divide the world into two groups now.
sentences.zh: 事实上，我大概把世界分为两组。

sentences.en: Jeremy Bentham, the great utilitarian philosopher, once spiked this argument.
sentences.zh: 杰里米·边沁 (Jeremy Bentham)， 著名的实用主义哲学家，曾经反对这个论点。他说：“世上有两种人，

sentences.en: He said, "There are two types of people in this world: those who divide the world into two types and those who do not."
sentences.zh: 一种人把世界分为两种，另一种则没有这样做。”

sentences.en: (Laughter) Well, I do. (Laughter) I meet all kinds of people who don't enjoy what they do.
sentences.zh: （笑声）其实，我支持这论点。（笑声）我遇到过各种各样的人，他们不喜欢他们正在做的事。他们简单过着他们的生活，只是对付。

sentences.en: They simply go through their lives getting on with it.
sentences.zh: 他们从他们的 工作中感受不到愉快。

sentences.en: They get no great pleasure from what they do.
sentences.zh: 他们忍受它，而不是享受它，

sentences.en: They endure it rather than enjoy it, and wait for the weekend.
sentences.zh: 只等着周末。

sentences.en: But I also meet people who love what they do and couldn't imagine doing anything else.
sentences.zh: 但是我也遇到过一些人，他们深爱着他们的工作，甚至不能想象他们在做别的事情。

sentences.en: If you said, "Don't do this anymore," they'd wonder what you're talking about.
sentences.zh: 如果你对他们说：“不要干这个了。”  他们会很难理解你在说什么。

sentences.en: It isn't what they do, it's who they are.
sentences.zh: 因为这和他们在干什么无关， 这就是他们。他们说：

sentences.en: They say, "But this is me, you know. It would be foolish to abandon this, because it speaks to my most authentic self."
sentences.zh: “但是这是我，你知道。如果我放弃这会让我显得很愚蠢，因为这就是我最真实的自我写照。”

sentences.en: And it's not true of enough people. In fact, on the contrary, I think it's still true of a minority of people.
sentences.zh: 许多人不是这样的。事实上，正相反，我认为这无疑只是一小部分人。

sentences.en: And I think there are many possible explanations for it.
sentences.zh: 我认为对此可能有许多解释。

sentences.en: And high among them is education, because education, in a way, dislocates very many people from their natural talents.
sentences.zh: 其中最可能的解释是教育，因为教育在某种程度上，使许多人远离其自身的天赋。

sentences.en: And human resources are like natural resources; they're often buried deep.
sentences.zh: 人力资源就像是自然资源；它们通常埋藏地很深。

sentences.en: You have to go looking for them, they're not just lying around on the surface.
sentences.zh: 你必须去找寻它们。它们不会只是躺在地表。

sentences.en: You have to create the circumstances where they show themselves.
sentences.zh: 你必须创造它们自我展现的环境。

sentences.en: And you might imagine education would be the way that happens, but too often, it's not.
sentences.zh: 你或许认为教育是让它们发生的环境。但是，许多时候，不是的。

sentences.en: Every education system in the world is being reformed at the moment and it's not enough.
sentences.zh: 世界上每个教育系统都是被改革过的。这是不足够的。

sentences.en: Reform is no use anymore, because that's simply improving a broken model.
sentences.zh: 改革不再有用了，因为它只简单地改进 一个已破碎的模式。

sentences.en: What we need -- and the word's been used many times in the past few days -- is not evolution, but a revolution in education.
sentences.zh: 我们需要的是 --这个词在过去的几天里， 已经被用过很多遍 --不是进化论，而是教育革命。

sentences.en: This has to be transformed into something else.
sentences.zh: 它一定要被转换成其它的形式。

sentences.en: (Applause) One of the real challenges is to innovate fundamentally in education.
sentences.zh: （掌声）其中最艰巨的挑战是对教育体系的彻底创新。

sentences.en: Innovation is hard, because it means doing something that people don't find very easy, for the most part.
sentences.zh: 创新是艰辛的，因为它意味着去干人们在大多数情况下 不是很容易去干的事情。

sentences.en: It means challenging what we take for granted, things that we think are obvious.
sentences.zh: 它意味着实实在在的挑战我们认为是明显的食物。

sentences.en: The great problem for reform or transformation is the tyranny of common sense.
sentences.zh: 重整或改革中最大的问题是社会常识的专政统治，

sentences.en: Things that people think, "It can't be done differently, that's how it's done."
sentences.zh: 人们认为，“事情是不能用其它方法做的， 因为他们是用这种方法做的。”

sentences.en: I came across a great quote recently from Abraham Lincoln, who I thought you'd be pleased to have quoted at this point.
sentences.zh: 我突然想起了亚伯拉罕·林肯  (Abraham Lincoln) 的经典句子，我想他一定高兴 他的句子用到了这里。

sentences.en: (Laughter) He said this in December 1862 to the second annual meeting of Congress.
sentences.zh: （笑声）他在1862年12月第二届年度会议中。

sentences.en: I ought to explain that I have no idea what was happening at the time.
sentences.zh: 我解释一下，对于当时发生了什么， 我完全不知道。

sentences.en: We don't teach American history in Britain.
sentences.zh: 我们在英国不教美国历史。

sentences.en: (Laughter) We suppress it. You know, this is our policy.
sentences.zh: （笑声）我们抑制它，你知道，这是我们的政策。

sentences.en: (Laughter) No doubt, something fascinating was happening then, which the Americans among us will be aware of.
sentences.zh: （笑声）因为，毋庸置疑，一件有吸引力的 事情在1862年12月发生了，我们中的美国人将会知道我说的。

sentences.en: But he said this: "The dogmas of the quiet past are inadequate to the stormy present.
sentences.zh: 他说到：“在平静的过去中的教条和暴风雨的现代是不相匹的。时机

sentences.en: The occasion is piled high with difficulty, and we must rise with the occasion."
sentences.zh: 被艰难地推到高处，我们必须和时机一起进步。”我喜欢这句话。

sentences.en: I love that. Not rise to it, rise with it.
sentences.zh: 不是为它进步，而是与时俱进。

sentences.en: "As our case is new, so we must think anew and act anew.
sentences.zh: “因为我们的处境是新的，我们必须重新思考，重新行动。

sentences.en: We must disenthrall ourselves, and then we shall save our country."
sentences.zh: 我们必须解放我们自己，然后才能拯救我们的国家。”

sentences.en: I love that word, "disenthrall." You know what it means?
sentences.zh: 我喜欢这个词“解放”你知道它的意义吗？

sentences.en: That there are ideas that all of us are enthralled to, which we simply take for granted as the natural order of things, the way things are.
sentences.zh: 我们所有人被解放到这些想法，我们理所当然的接受它，就像自然的事物，就是这样。

sentences.en: And many of our ideas have been formed, not to meet the circumstances of this century, but to cope with the circumstances of previous centuries.
sentences.zh: 许多我们的想法已成型了，它们是不能和这个世纪的 客观环境相融合的，它们只能对付上个世纪的环境。

sentences.en: But our minds are still hypnotized by them, and we have to disenthrall ourselves of some of them.
sentences.zh: 但是我们的想法仍旧被它催眠者。我们必须多多少少 从中解放出来。

sentences.en: Now, doing this is easier said than done.
sentences.zh: 说是比做容易。

sentences.en: It's very hard to know, by the way, what it is you take for granted.
sentences.zh: 此外，很难知道， 你认为什么是理所当然的。

sentences.en: And the reason is that you take it for granted.
sentences.zh: 还有，为什么你认为它是理所当然的。

sentences.en: (Laughter) Let me ask you something you may take for granted.
sentences.zh: 让我问你一些问题， 你可能认为是理所当然的。

sentences.en: How many of you here are over the age of 25?
sentences.zh: 在座的有多少人是 25 岁以上？

sentences.en: That's not what you take for granted, I'm sure you're familiar with that.
sentences.zh: 这不是我认为你是理所当然的。我确信你很熟悉这个。

sentences.en: Are there any people here under the age of 25?
sentences.zh: 有人小于25岁吗？

sentences.en: Great. Now, those over 25, could you put your hands up if you're wearing your wristwatch?
sentences.zh: 很好，那些大于25岁的，如果你带一块腕表，请把手举起来。

sentences.en: Now that's a great deal of us, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 腕表对于我们很有用，不是吗？

sentences.en: Ask a room full of teenagers the same thing.
sentences.zh: 那同样的问题 问一屋子十几岁的年轻人。

sentences.en: Teenagers do not wear wristwatches. I don't mean they can't, they just often choose not to.
sentences.zh: 年轻人不带腕表。我不是说他们不能或者他们不许，他们只是常常选择不带。

sentences.en: And the reason is we were brought up in a pre-digital culture, those of us over 25.
sentences.zh: 原因是，你看，我们这些25岁以上的，是在数字时代前的文化中养育大的。

sentences.en: And so for us, if you want to know the time, you have to wear something to tell it.
sentences.zh: 因为对于我们，如果你想要知道时间，你不得不带个什么东西来告诉你。

sentences.en: Kids now live in a world which is digitized, and the time, for them, is everywhere.
sentences.zh: 孩子们现在生活在数字时代，时间对于他们来讲，到处都是。

sentences.en: They see no reason to do this. And by the way, you don't need either; it's just that you've always done it and you carry on doing it.
sentences.zh: 他们不理解为什么带手表。顺便说一句，你同样也不需要；仅仅是因为你习惯了， 你就继续做下去。

sentences.en: My daughter never wears a watch, my daughter Kate, who's 20.
sentences.zh: 我女儿从不带手表， 我女儿凯特20岁。

sentences.en: She doesn't see the point. As she says, "It's a single-function device."
sentences.zh: 她看不到手表的重要性。她说：“这是单一功能的装置。”

sentences.en: (Laughter) "Like, how lame is that?" And I say, "No, no, it tells the date as well."
sentences.zh: （笑声）就像它是多蹩脚的。我说：“不不，它同样也显示时间。”

sentences.en: (Laughter) "It has multiple functions." (Laughter) But, you see, there are things we're enthralled to in education.
sentences.zh: （笑声）“它有多重功能。”但是，你看，这就是 我们被教育束缚的事情。让我再举些例子。

sentences.en: A couple of examples. One of them is the idea of linearity: that it starts here and you go through a track and if you do everything right, you will end up set for the rest of your life.
sentences.zh: 它们中的一个是线性想法。从这里开始，你在一个轨道上前进，如果你做对每件事，你就到达你后半生想要的生活。

sentences.en: Everybody who's spoken at TED has told us implicitly, or sometimes explicitly, a different story: that life is not linear; it's organic.
sentences.zh: 每个在TED演讲的人 都婉转或明确地向我们诉说不同的故事：生活不是线性的，它是有机的。我们创造我们共同的生活，

sentences.en: We create our lives symbiotically as we explore our talents in relation to the circumstances they help to create for us.
sentences.zh: 就像我们发觉我们的天赋，和天赋帮助我们创造自我的关系。

sentences.en: But, you know, we have become obsessed with this linear narrative.
sentences.zh: 但是你知道，我们变得对这个线性故事很著迷。

sentences.en: And probably the pinnacle for education is getting you to college.
sentences.zh: 可能是教育的顶峰是被大学录取。

sentences.en: I think we are obsessed with getting people to college.
sentences.zh: 我认为执迷于让人们进入大学，

sentences.en: Certain sorts of college. I don't mean you shouldn't go, but not everybody needs to go, or go now.
sentences.zh: 进入某种类型的大学。我不是说你不应该上大学， 但是不是每个人都需要上大学，尤其是现在。

sentences.en: Maybe they go later, not right away. And I was up in San Francisco a while ago doing a book signing.
sentences.zh: 他们可以迟一点上大学，不一定马上。我前一阵子在旧金山举行新书签名会。

sentences.en: There was this guy buying a book, he was in his 30s.
sentences.zh: 其中有一个30岁左右 的男人买我的书。

sentences.en: I said, "What do you do?" And he said, "I'm a fireman."
sentences.zh: 我问到：“你是干什么的？”他说：“我是消防员。”

sentences.en: I asked, "How long have you been a fireman?"
sentences.zh: 我又问：“你当消防员多久了？”

sentences.en: "Always. I've always been a fireman." "Well, when did you decide?" He said, "As a kid.
sentences.zh: 他说：“一辈子，我一直就是个消防员。”我说：“哦，你什么时候决定的？”

sentences.en: Actually, it was a problem for me at school, because at school, everybody wanted to be a fireman."
sentences.zh: 他说：“很小的时候。” 他说： “事实上，这让我在中学时遇到了困难，因为学校里的每个人 都想成为消防员。”

sentences.en: (Laughter) He said, "But I wanted to be a fireman."
sentences.zh: 他说：“我想成为消防员。”

sentences.en: And he said, "When I got to the senior year of school, my teachers didn't take it seriously.
sentences.zh: 他又说：“当我升上高年级的时候，我的老师们不以为然。

sentences.en: This one teacher didn't take it seriously.
sentences.zh: 有一个老师，特别不以为然，

sentences.en: He said I was throwing my life away if that's all I chose to do with it; that I should go to college, I should become a professional person, that I had great potential and I was wasting my talent to do that."
sentences.zh: 他说如果这是我全部的选择，我就是在荒废我的青春。我应该上大学，成为一个职业白领，我有很大的潜能，如果这么做的话， 我就是在浪费我的天赋。”

sentences.en: He said, "It was humiliating. It was in front of the whole class and I felt dreadful.
sentences.zh: 他又说：“这使我感到羞辱，因为那个老师在全班面前说了此话， 我感到糟糕透了。

sentences.en: But it's what I wanted, and as soon as I left school, I applied to the fire service and I was accepted.
sentences.zh: 但是这就是我想要的， 从中学毕业后，我马上申请了消防工作，并且被录取了。”

sentences.en: You know, I was thinking about that guy recently, just a few minutes ago when you were speaking, about this teacher, because six months ago, I saved his life."
sentences.zh: 他说：“你知道，在你问我的几秒钟前，我突然想起了那个老师。”他说：“因为六个月前，我挽救了他的生命。”

sentences.en: (Laughter) He said, "He was in a car wreck, and I pulled him out, gave him CPR, and I saved his wife's life as well."
sentences.zh: （笑声）他说：“他在一辆严重损坏的汽车里，我把他拉了出来， 给他做了心脏起博复苏，我同时也救了他的妻子。”

sentences.en: He said, "I think he thinks better of me now."
sentences.zh: 他说：“我认为他现在 对我的想法要好多了。”（笑声）

sentences.en: (Laughter) (Applause) You know, to me, human communities depend upon a diversity of talent,
sentences.zh: （掌声）你知道，对于我来说，人类社会取决于天赋的多样性，

sentences.en: not a singular conception of ability. And at the heart of our challenges -- (Applause) At the heart of the challenge is to reconstitute our sense of ability and of intelligence.
sentences.zh: 不是单一能力的思维。在我们挑战的中心 --（掌声）在我们挑战的中心是重新组建我们的能力和智慧。

sentences.en: This linearity thing is a problem. When I arrived in L.A. about nine years ago, I came across a policy statement -- very well-intentioned -- which said, "College begins in kindergarten."
sentences.zh: 线性思考是一个问题。当我九年前来到洛杉矶的时候，我对一种观点有很深的印象，一种非常有意识的政策宣言：“大学起始于幼儿园。”

sentences.en: No, it doesn't. (Laughter) It doesn't. If we had time, I could go into this, but we don't.
sentences.zh: 不，不是这样的。（笑声）不是这样的。如果我有时间， 我会在这里详细说明，但是我没有。

sentences.en: (Laughter) Kindergarten begins in kindergarten.
sentences.zh: （笑声）幼儿园起始于幼儿园。（笑声）

sentences.en: (Laughter) A friend of mine once said, "A three year-old is not half a six year-old."
sentences.zh: 我的一个朋友曾经说过：”你知道，三岁的孩童 不是六岁孩童的一半。“

sentences.en: (Laughter) (Applause) They're three. But as we just heard in this last session, there's such competition now to get into kindergarten --
sentences.zh: （笑声）（掌声）他们三岁。就像我们上边听到的那个例子，上幼儿园的竞争很大，

sentences.en: to get to the right kindergarten -- that people are being interviewed for it at three.
sentences.zh: 尤其是上对的幼儿园，三岁就要开始面试。三岁！

sentences.en: Kids sitting in front of unimpressed panels, you know, with their resumes -- (Laughter) Flicking through and saying, "What, this is it?"
sentences.zh: 孩子们坐在无聊的专家咨询组前，你知道，带着他们的简历。（笑声）草草翻阅，然后说：“就这些？”

sentences.en: (Laughter) (Applause) "You've been around for 36 months, and this is it?"
sentences.zh: （笑声）（掌声）“你已经在这儿混了三十六个月了，就这些？”

sentences.en: (Laughter) "You've achieved nothing -- commit.
sentences.zh: （笑声）“你没有完成任何事情，这是我的意见。

sentences.en: (Laughter) Spent the first six months breastfeeding, I can see."
sentences.zh: 母乳喂养了六个月，这就只是我能看到的。”

sentences.en: (Laughter) See, it's outrageous as a conception.
sentences.zh: （笑声）看，这个想法是无法容忍的， 但是它吸引着我们。

sentences.en: The other big issue is conformity. We have built our education systems on the model of fast food.
sentences.zh: 另一个很大的问题是循规蹈矩。我们把我们的教育系统建立在快餐的基础上。

sentences.en: This is something Jamie Oliver talked about the other day.
sentences.zh: 杰米·奥利弗曾经提到这个问题。

sentences.en: There are two models of quality assurance in catering.
sentences.zh: 你知道高质量保证的 饮食业有两种形态。一是快餐，

sentences.en: One is fast food, where everything is standardized.
sentences.zh: 全部标准化。

sentences.en: The other is like Zagat and Michelin restaurants, where everything is not standardized, they're customized to local circumstances.
sentences.zh: 二是像扎格特和米什兰饭店，全不标准化，它们制定标准满足当地情况。

sentences.en: And we have sold ourselves into a fast-food model of education, and it's impoverishing our spirit and our energies as much as fast food is depleting our physical bodies.
sentences.zh: 我们出让我们自己， 建立快餐模式的教育。它正在耗尽我们的精神和能量，就像快餐正在耗尽 我们的身体资源。

sentences.en: (Applause) We have to recognize a couple of things here.
sentences.zh: （掌声）我认为我们在这里 必须认识到一些事情。

sentences.en: One is that human talent is tremendously diverse.
sentences.zh: 其一是人类天赋有巨大的多样性。

sentences.en: People have very different aptitudes. I worked out recently that I was given a guitar as a kid at about the same time that Eric Clapton got his first guitar.
sentences.zh: 人们有非常不同的天资。我最近才发觉一件事：我在很小的时候得到了一个吉他，大概是埃里克·克莱普顿 得到他的第一个吉他的时候。

sentences.en: (Laughter) It worked out for Eric, that's all I'm saying.
sentences.zh: 你知道，埃里克成功了，我仅想说这个。

sentences.en: (Laughter) In a way -- it did not for me.
sentences.zh: （笑声）在某种方式上，它在我身上不起作用。

sentences.en: I could not get this thing to work no matter how often or how hard I blew into it.
sentences.zh: 我不能使吉他工作，无论多经常，或是多努力地弹它。

sentences.en: It just wouldn't work. (Laughter) But it's not only about that.
sentences.zh: 它就是不工作。不仅仅是这样。

sentences.en: It's about passion. Often, people are good at things they don't really care for.
sentences.zh: 这和热情息息相关。通常，人们善于去做 他们不用太花心思去做的事情。

sentences.en: It's about passion, and what excites our spirit and our energy.
sentences.zh: 是热情，使我们精力和能量兴奋。

sentences.en: And if you're doing the thing that you love to do, that you're good at, time takes a different course entirely.
sentences.zh: 如果你正在做你热爱的事情，你花在这件事上的时间便不同。

sentences.en: My wife's just finished writing a novel, and I think it's a great book, but she disappears for hours on end.
sentences.zh: 我妻子刚完成了一部小说，我认为它是极好的书。写这本书的结尾时， 她消失了好几个小时。

sentences.en: You know this, if you're doing something you love, an hour feels like five minutes.
sentences.zh: 你知道，如果你正在做你喜爱的事情，一小时感觉就像五分钟。

sentences.en: If you're doing something that doesn't resonate with your spirit, five minutes feels like an hour.
sentences.zh: 如果你正在做一件 不和你精神发生共鸣的事情，五分钟就像是一小时。

sentences.en: And the reason so many people are opting out of education is because it doesn't feed their spirit, it doesn't feed their energy or their passion.
sentences.zh: 许多人退出教育的原因是教育对他们的精力起不到供给，供给不到他们的精力和热情。

sentences.en: So I think we have to change metaphors. We have to go from what is essentially an industrial model of education, a manufacturing model, which is based on linearity and conformity and batching people.
sentences.zh: 因此，我认为我们必须改变暗喻。我们必须从基于工业化的制造业的教育模式，这个模式是基于线性的，标准化的和批量生产的人们，

sentences.en: We have to move to a model that is based more on principles of agriculture.
sentences.zh: 我们必须移到一个基于农业生产原理的模式。

sentences.en: We have to recognize that human flourishing is not a mechanical process; it's an organic process.
sentences.zh: 我们必须认识到 人类的蒸蒸日上不是一个工业制造的过程，是一个有机的过程。

sentences.en: And you cannot predict the outcome of human development.
sentences.zh: 而且你不能预计人类发展的结果；

sentences.en: All you can do, like a farmer, is create the conditions under which they will begin to flourish.
sentences.zh: 所有你能做的，就像种庄稼的，建造使它们开始开花的条件。

sentences.en: So when we look at reforming education and transforming it, it isn't like cloning a system.
sentences.zh: 因此，当我们看待 教育改革和教育改造，它不会像是复制一个系统

sentences.en: There are great ones, like KIPP's; it's a great system.
sentences.zh: 像 KIPPs，尽管它是极好的系统，

sentences.en: There are many great models. It's about customizing to your circumstances and personalizing education to the people you're actually teaching.
sentences.zh: 有许多极好的模式。而是对你真正教的人们个人化教育环境，个人化教育。

sentences.en: And doing that, I think, is the answer to the future because it's not about scaling a new solution; it's about creating a movement in education in which people develop their own solutions, but with external support based on a personalized curriculum.
sentences.zh: 做这事，我认为是对未来的道路。因为它不是找出一个新的解决办法；是关于发展一个教育运动，其中人们开发他们自己的解决办法，同时得到基于个人条件的外在支持。

sentences.en: Now in this room, there are people who represent extraordinary resources in business, in multimedia, in the Internet.
sentences.zh: 现在，在这个房间，有人拥有商业中非凡的资源，在多媒体，在互联网。

sentences.en: These technologies, combined with the extraordinary talents of teachers, provide an opportunity to revolutionize education.
sentences.zh: 这些科技，和教师卓越的天赋相结合，提供了一个教育革命的机会。

sentences.en: And I urge you to get involved in it because it's vital, not just to ourselves, but to the future of our children.
sentences.zh: 我鼓励你参与其中，因为它是极重要的， 不仅是对我们自身，而是对我们孩子的未来。

sentences.en: But we have to change from the industrial model to an agricultural model, where each school can be flourishing tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 但是我们必须从工业模式中解放，变成农业模式，当中，每个学校明天就能繁荣兴盛。

sentences.en: That's where children experience life. Or at home, if that's what they choose, to be educated with their families or friends.
sentences.zh: 它是孩子们的经验生活。或者在家，如果那是他们和他家人朋友选择被教育的地方。

sentences.en: There's been a lot of talk about dreams over the course of these few days.
sentences.zh: 在过去的几天里，有很多关于梦想的演讲。

sentences.en: And I wanted to just very quickly -- I was very struck by Natalie Merchant's songs last night, recovering old poems.
sentences.zh: 我只想很快 --娜塔莉·莫奇的歌困在我的脑海里，寻回久的诗歌。

sentences.en: I wanted to read you a quick, very short poem from W. B. Yeats, who some of you may know.
sentences.zh: 我想要读一个快的短的诗歌，W.B.·叶芝，他是你可能知道的某个人。

sentences.en: He wrote this to his love, Maud Gonne, and he was bewailing the fact that he couldn't really give her what he thought she wanted from him.
sentences.zh: 他写给他的爱人，昴德·冈昂，他正在为事实痛苦，他不能真的给她，他认为她想要的。

sentences.en: And he says, "I've got something else, but it may not be for you."
sentences.zh: 他说：“我有一些另外的东西，但它并不是给你的。”

sentences.en: He says this: "Had I the heavens' embroidered cloths, Enwrought with gold and silver light, The blue and the dim and the dark cloths
sentences.zh: 他说：“天堂已经在衣服上刺绣了，用金色和银色的灯光，蓝色的，暗淡的，和黑色的衣服，

sentences.en: Of night and light and the half-light, I would spread the cloths under your feet: But I, being poor, have only my dreams; I have spread my dreams under your feet;
sentences.zh: 用夜色的灯光和半灯光，我将衣服延展到你脚下；但是我，这个穷困者，只有我的梦想；我延伸我的梦想到你脚下；

sentences.en: Tread softly because you tread on my dreams."
sentences.zh: 轻轻的踩，因为你正在踩我的梦想上。”

sentences.en: And every day, everywhere, our children spread their dreams beneath our feet.
sentences.zh: 每天，每处，我们的孩子延伸 他们的梦想到你脚下。

sentences.en: And we should tread softly. Thank you. (Applause) Thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 我们应该轻轻地踩。谢谢。

sentences.en: (Applause) Thank you. (Applause)
sentences.zh: （掌声）
